segments.note: PROVISIONAL reconciliation by Codex (GPT-6). Opening bzhi (ACIP BZHI) contradicts published three and is omitted, never labelled no-exponent or paired with three; the existing TODO item remains the sole pending erratum. The final gsum maps to the later three of the definite subgroup. The overt experienced in each label belongs to that label's myong; the next-life and further-life explanations omit their repeated experience predicate, while the first explanation retains experience. All vedaniya auxiliaries are left unassigned where lead to, future, and ripen distribute meaning across the recast English; omission does not assert no exponent. The complete temporal paraphrases are d=3, outside the dictionary: tshe de'i yang phyi ma phan chad la / in any life after the next, and lan grangs gzhan / "some other" life. In the former, de'i refers back to the next life: this later phyi ma does not itself mean the English next. lan grangs is an occasion/count term and is not independently banked as life. mthong chos retains the supported seen and something members. dang po, the final las, and yod pa'i remain omitted as restructuring. C16:754 repeats all three source fields exactly and is a same-lineage re-ingest, not independent correction evidence.
